payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iteratively compute Grundy numbers for states (a,b) by taking mex over moves (a+1,b) and (a,b+1), with 2D memoization for states under threshold.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D state (a,b) dynamic programming to solve an impartial game, computing Grundy numbers bottom-up, characteristic of dp_2d_state.
